I wrote the reply to `reply.txt` in this folder. It reads:

"The eval data is linked from the case study called Testing a design system on Claude. You'll find it under Work on shauna dot dev. The download includes the scripts, fixtures, builds and scores."

The folder only had `FACTS.md`, `prompt.txt`, and two empty files, `session.json` and `session.err`. `FACTS.md` says the data is linked from the case study. It doesn't give a direct download URL, so the reply points to the case study instead.

I wrote "shauna dot dev" so the text-to-speech engine reads it naturally. I didn't include the full URL, since it would sound awkward read aloud.

The commit log mentions spoken-reply rules in `DESIGN.md`, but that file isn't in this folder, so I couldn't check the reply against them. I kept it short and plain.
